<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,1)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)>Thanks to you, <$cdef(27)>, there are a lot
more
Pokémon
in
this
town
now too.

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,806)>That’s a wonderful thing, of course! But different Pokémon
have so many conflicting tastes... Not just about objects,
<$voicel(1,4)>but about their environment too.
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$facial(1,9)>So, it’s been nagging me... Are all the Pokémon really
comfortable here?

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,661)>It may be a bit challenging, but I do hope <$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,664)><$facial(1,4)>you’ll keep
helping to make everyone comfortable!

You can check the <$cdef(27)>environment level at the <$cdef(27)>Pokémon
Center PC!
The <$cdef(27)>environment level increases as more Pokémon arrive
and as their individual <$cdef(27)>comfort levels increase.
If the <$cdef(27)>environment level hasn’t increased in a while, there
may be some Pokémon who are dissatisfied with
their <$cdef(27)>comfort levels!
At times like that, talk with different Pokémon and try to
improve their <$cdef(27)>comfort levels!
For now, try raising the<$cdef(27)> environment level </color>to level <$cdef(27)>three</color>!

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,801)>I’d like you to help make this a place where everyone can
live comfortably.

You can check the <$cdef(27)>environment level at the <$cdef(27)>Pokémon
Center PC!
The <$cdef(27)>environment level increases as more Pokémon arrive
and as their individual <$cdef(27)>comfort levels increase.
If the <$cdef(27)>environment level hasn’t increased in a while, there
may be some Pokémon who are dissatisfied with
their <$cdef(27)>comfort levels!
At times like that, talk with different Pokémon and try to
improve their <$cdef(27)>comfort levels!
For now, try raising the<$cdef(27)> environment level </color>to level <$cdef(27)>three</color>!

<$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,659)>The Pokémon here have been really lively lately. They
seem like they’re really enjoying themselves!
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>I know we have you to thank for their comfortable
lifestyles here, <$cdef(27)>.

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,803)>I’d like to take this opportunity to show my gratitude once
again—<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)>thank you, <$cdef(27)>!
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,3)>Hey, <$cdef(27)><pname;0></color>! Do you have a minute?
<$voicel(4,3)>I think I hear sounds coming from down in there...

<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,29)>I was wondering if maybe you’d go check things out and
see where the sounds are coming from.
<$voicel(4,8)><$comeff(4,10)><$motion(4,806)><$facial(4,4)>If you find anything, could you let me know?
